description: Every ThreatDown OneView API, plus fleet-wide stale-endpoint, health and seat reports across all your sites, and guarded isolate/scan/restore jobs.

novel_features.name: Stale endpoints fleet query
novel_features.description: Every endpoint not seen in N hours across all your sites, with site name and exact hours since last seen.

novel_features.name: Per-site health scorecard
novel_features.description: One ranked row per site with total, online, stale, infected, suspicious, isolated, reboot-required, unprotected, scan-overdue and update-available counts plus an attention score.

novel_features.name: Cross-site fleet sync
novel_features.description: Pull sites, endpoints, detections and jobs from every managed site into one local database.

novel_features.name: Guarded response jobs
novel_features.description: Isolate endpoints by host name with a target preview and a 25-endpoint blast-radius guard; sibling commands respond restore, respond scan, respond reboot and respond update work the same way.

novel_features.name: Jobs that never ran
novel_features.description: Jobs that timed out, expired or failed, plus jobs still waiting after --min-age (default 1h), grouped by site and command with a re-issue hint.

novel_features.name: Seat reconciliation
novel_features.description: Per-site seat allocations compared with deployed and recently seen endpoints, with expiry flags.

novel_features.name: Cross-site threat spread
novel_features.description: Every threat in a window ranked by reach (distinct sites and endpoints), by hash or threat name; add --min-sites 2 for cross-site threats only.

novel_features.name: Actionable triage queue
novel_features.description: Prioritized list of infected or suspicious endpoints with online and isolated state and a suggested response.

novel_features.name: One-customer profile
novel_features.description: Everything about one customer site in one output: health, stale machines, top threats, isolated endpoints and pending jobs.
